## I Love Fremont.
#### “Our communities, our cultures, our non-profits, and our businesses make Fremont the great city that I love.”
That’s why I am serving as City Council Member and President of the Fremont Education Foundation. That’s why I have served as Fremont Senior Citizens Commissioner, Fremont Chamber of Commerce Government Affairs Committee member, President of the Centerville Business & Community Association, President of the Rotary Club of Fremont, and Co-founder of the Tri-City NonProfit Coalition.
## I thrive on building community.
#### “Collaboration is my favorite word.”
I use my passion to build teams, forge solidarity, and find solutions.
I’ll work collaboratively with you to help bring jobs to our city and grow our community. I’m ready to address key areas including growth, traffic, homelessness, challenges for businesses, support for nonprofits, and public safety. I unite people and organizations, fostering collaboration and ensuring every resident feels heard, valued, and represented.
## I’m working to keep Fremont a city we’re all proud to call home.
I’d be honored to earn your trust and win your vote.
I will follow the California ELECTION CODE OF FAIR CAMPAIGN PRACTICES. I invite my opponent and everyone else running for a seat in Fremont government to join me in running a fair and honest campaign. (Election Code § 20440)
